President Donald Trump is hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping for a state dinner Thursday night. It is the kind of welcome Trump said he would refuse to give Xi when he first ran for president a decade ago. Trump went on to take a confrontational approach toward China, imposing tariffs and clashing with Beijing over trade. More recently, his language toward Xi has softened: Trump has praised their personal relationship as the two adversaries try to manage their many disagreements. Now Xi is back at the White House, where the three-course state dinner features yellow squash velouté, sesame-crusted sea bass and vanilla crémeux.
